journey.title: Tab stays inside the upload dialog when it contains a hidden button
journey.goal: Tabbing past the last visible control wraps to the start of the dialog

steps.title: Tab past the last visible control

functionalJourney.title: Upload a report with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: The dialog opens, uploads and closes

guards.title: Escape closes the upload dialog and returns focus
guards.goal: Escape dismisses the dialog and focus returns to the trigger

plan.root_cause: The hidden retry button inside the modal remains in the tab order (no tabindex=-1 or aria-hidden), so when Tab passes the last visible control the browser skips the non‑focusable hidden button and moves focus to the next focusable element outside the modal, breaking the focus trap.
plan.repair_strategy: Add tabindex="-1" to the hidden retry button to remove it from the tab order, ensuring the last focusable element inside the modal is the Upload button so that Tab wraps to the first focusable element (the Close button) as expected.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Tabbing within the modal will loop focus between the modal's focusable elements, preventing focus from escaping to elements outside the modal.
functional_risks: If the retry button is later made visible via script without removing tabindex=-1, it would be keyboard inaccessible.
Adding tabindex=-1 has no effect while the button is hidden via display:none, so there is no impact on current functionality or screen reader announcement.
verification_requirements: Verify that pressing Tab from the Upload button moves focus to the Close button (or first focusable element) and not to the Help link outside the modal.
Confirm that Escape still closes the dialog and returns focus to the triggering button.
Ensure that opening the dialog still sets initial focus to the filename input as specified.
Check that the visual state and functional behavior of the upload process remain unchanged.

plan.root_cause: The hidden retry button (display:none) lacks aria-hidden, so MicroModal's focusable node list includes it. When tabbing from the Upload button, the script thinks there is another focusable node (the retry button) after it, so it doesn't wrap focus to the first node. The browser then tabs to the next focusable element outside the modal (the Help link).
plan.repair_strategy: Add aria-hidden="true" to the hidden retry button so it is excluded from MicroModal's focusable node list, making the Upload button the last focusable node and enabling proper focus wrap to the Close button.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Tabbing within the modal will loop focus between the modal's focusable elements (filename input, Upload button, Close button), preventing focus from escaping to elements outside the modal.
functional_risks: If the retry button is later made visible via script without removing aria-hidden, it would be keyboard inaccessible.
Adding aria-hidden has no visual impact because the button is already hidden via display:none, so current functionality is unchanged.
verification_requirements: Verify that pressing Tab from the Upload button moves focus to the Close button (or first focusable element) and not to the Help link outside the modal.
Confirm that Escape still closes the dialog and returns focus to the triggering button.
Ensure that opening the dialog still sets initial focus to the filename input as specified.
Check that the visual state and functional behavior of the upload process remain unchanged.
